answer: Rotating Entry Lottery. Each round, a public verifiable random function picks which agent identities may submit work; only selected IDs can post a valid signal. Applicants must pre-commit an unguessable per-round key, so an attacker cannot know in advance which of thousands of puppets will be eligible. Like a sonnet's fixed meter, the schedule constrains who may act, and no early computation tells you if your lantern will be lit.
